device.modelDescription: Step module of the ch-packs family: cleans one GitHub Actions job log into its steps, so later steps see the output a person would read and nothing else. A pure function of its input: no disk, no network, no state.

actionList.name: clean
actionList.description: Cleans one GitHub Actions job log, as the logs endpoint returns it, into steps. Strips the byte-order mark, the timestamp on every line, ANSI escapes, group markers, progress lines (percentages, spinners, git's 'Receiving objects' and 'Resolving deltas') and blank lines; keeps ##[error] and ##[warning] lines with their marker. A step starts at its '##[group]Run <command>' header and is named after it; post steps start at 'Post job cleanup.'; lines before the first step are the step '(top)'. Returns the steps in order, how many lines the log had and how many were kept.
